info.title: UrbanAgent Traveler API v2
info.summary: Traveler API v2 contract for city metadata, POI search, POI detail, recommendations, and stateless trip preview.
info.description: This draft covers approved Phase 2 Batch 1, Batch 2, and Batch 3 core endpoints. Trip persistence, saved trips, edit, replan, feedback persistence, booking, live opening hours, external routing, external POI ingestion, and production database rollout endpoints are intentionally excluded.

get.summary: Read dataset, quality, and capability status for one city.
Search traveler POIs with deterministic pagination.
Read one traveler POI by canonical ID.

post.summary: Recommend traveler POIs for one city-scoped query.
Create a deterministic non-persistent trip preview.

200.description: Trip preview response. May be feasible, feasible with warnings, partial, or infeasible.

422.description: Unsupported city or impossible hard trip constraints.

error.message: Only da-nang is supported in this release.
The requested hard trip constraints cannot produce a feasible itinerary.

RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-Id
RequestIdHeader.description: Optional caller request ID. Invalid values are replaced by a generated server request ID.

PoiIdPath.name: poiId
PoiIdPath.description: Canonical Global_ID exposed as the public POI ID.

SourceQuery.name: source
SourceQuery.description: Source compatibility filter. Unknown values use the Google-compatible default.

CursorQuery.name: cursor
CursorQuery.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous page.

CityNotSupported.description: The requested city is not supported.

DailyWindow.description: Same-day local HH:mm window; span must be 15 to 480 minutes.

tripId.description: No persistent trip ID is returned in Batch 3.

distanceMeters.description: Null when origin or coordinates are unknown.

travelDurationMinutes.description: Null when origin or coordinates are unknown.
